# Atlas: The Cala Knight - Canon Card

<!-- generated from content/studio/canon/glossary.json by scripts/canon_card.mjs; do not edit -->

## Premise

**The gods tried to save tomorrow. The Architect stole it.**

> Long ago, the world began running out of tomorrows.
> Six gods tried to save it, each in their own way. But their miracles clashed, and the world began to break. A mortal known as the Architect built the Great Kilns, sealing the gods away and restoring the passage of time.
> Centuries passed. Brass clocks measured the hours, porcelain held them, and lanterns lit the kingdoms. People lived, laughed, and forgot how close the world had come to ending.
> Now the porcelain is cracking. Forgotten memories are awakening, and entire villages are losing hours.
> You are an independent traveller. Your first duty is simple: mend what is broken.

## Naming rule

- Title stays Atlas: The Cala Knight. Every new proper name is an Elvish root (Tolkien's Quenya or Sindarin) plus a plain English word, or plain evocative English.
- Build names from roots, never from existing Tolkien names (no Gondor, Elrond, Silmaril, Voronwë, Tamar).
- At most two names per first letter across races, gods and the Architect. No near-twins such as Nira/Nara.
- Names must be easy to say in Thai and English. Avoid th and heavy consonant clusters.
- Every key English word (Hearth, Oath, Watch, ...) is used in at most one key name.

## Titles

- **Cala Knight**: Q cala, light. A rare legendary title held by a handful of historical heroes, numbered by person. NOT the player order; players never earn it.
- **Kilnwatch Wardens**: Plain English. Optional player faction at Kilnwatch Bastion, joinable at Lv 10.
- **Cala Keep**: Q cala + Keep. Kept as the historical Cala Knights' keep; unassigned in play until a story needs it.
- **The Last Cala Knight**: the most recent person to hold the title, a woman. No ordinal is ever stated; how many Cala Knights there were is unknown. Her name, race, era and the thing she left unfinished are revealed only through traces (Ch 0-VIII). Expansion I retraces her story.

## Landmarks

- **The Great Bell** (ระฆังใหญ่): It hangs between two towering cliffs among hundreds of brass lanterns; giant porcelain ribs protrude from the valley walls; a winding lantern-lit road leads tiny travellers to the bell. Composition: hanging lanterns (foreground) -> village road (path) -> Great Bell (landmark) -> porcelain ribs (mega-forms)

## Kilnwatch Wardens

Joining quest: q-warden-join-01 "A Place on the Watch" (Lv 10): repair a damaged signal-post lantern, deliver the incident report, sign the Wardens' public service ledger. No exam, no prophecy, no birth check.

| Rank | Thai | Requirement | Unlocks |
|---|---|---|---|
| Runner | รันเนอร์ | joining quest | Warden board quests, +10 storage slots, faction affiliation title |
| Warden | วอร์เดน | 100 Warden reputation | +20 storage total, Warden cloak cosmetic, 5% discount on Warden consumables |
| Elder Warden | เอลเดอร์ วอร์เดน | 350 Warden reputation | +30 storage total, lantern accessory cosmetic, convenience teleport to Kilnwatch Bastion |

Never gated: main story and chapters, dungeons, raids, world bosses, markets, ordinary storage, equipment progression, every Cala Knight discovery, no faction-exclusive combat power

Leave / return: resign at the registrar any time; rank and reputation are kept, bonuses pause and resume on rejoining; no fee.

Legend link: the Wardens keep an incomplete ledger associated with the Last Cala Knight; membership gives no claim to her title.
